summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Alamos Gold Inc., a foreign private issuer, containing a management proxy circular and notice of annual general meeting of shareholders. The meeting will cover routine items: receiving financial statements, electing 11 directors, reappointing auditors, and a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation. No special-situation transaction, corporate action, or event is involved. This is a standard annual meeting notice with no M&A, restructuring, or capital markets event. As a routine circular, it does not qualify as a special situation.
